name: ahu_0005
description: Flag an air handler whose supply air leaves noticeably colder than the mixed air entering it while it should be heating or idle. Raise the fault only after the condition has lasted for the alarm delay.

inputs.name: mat
inputs.meaning: Mixed air temperature, measured after outdoor and return air mix

inputs.name: sat
inputs.meaning: Supply air temperature, measured at the discharge

outputs.name: yFault
outputs.meaning: True while supply air has stayed more than the gap threshold below mixed air for at least the alarm delay

params.name: mat_sat_gap_threshold
params.meaning: How far supply air may sit below mixed air before it counts

params.name: alarm_delay
params.meaning: How long the condition must persist

logic:
gap = mat - sat
fault_now = gap > mat_sat_gap_threshold
yFault = fault_now held true for alarm_delay
